name: closing card lists the skill tags and signs off available for work
looks: A thin hairline draws across the top, then a role label, a bold display name and a row of small rounded skill-tag pills settle in on a dark field, the last pill lit in the accent colour. A second pass adds one more tag and a small glowing dot with an availability line, while a faint ring quietly rotates in the background.
build: A hairline scales in from one end, the role label and name fade/rise in together, then the tag pills stagger in left to right (power2.out, ~60-80ms apart) with the final pill getting an accent fill and a soft glow; the availability dot pulses gently and its label fades in last, held static as the backdrop keeps a slow, barely-visible rotation.
sound: A soft swell as the hairline draws, a light tick per pill landing, and a final soft chime on the availability line.
prompt: Close on a simple credentials card: a drawn hairline, a role and name, and a row of small skill-tag pills that land one after another with the last one lit in the accent colour, finishing on a quietly pulsing availability dot and line, held on a calm, almost-still backdrop.
